meta.home.desc: Blades of Ages is a one-thumb action game for iPhone and iPad: outward-facing blades spin around your hero across {eras} ages, {realms} mythological realms and {maps} maps.

hero.title: The blades spin. You walk.
hero.lead: Blades of Ages is a one-thumb action game in which outward-facing blades spin around your hero. Cut through waves of monsters and defeat bosses across {eras} ages and {realms} mythological realms.
hero.hint.pointer: Move the cursor and the hero follows. Stop, and the blades draw in and spin faster.
hero.hint.touch: Touch and drag. Lift your finger and the blades draw in and spin faster.
hero.canvas: Playable demo: blades spinning around the hero cut down Göbekli Tepe monsters coming from four directions; defeated monsters turn into gold.
how.title: One thumb, two orbits
how.lead: No extra buttons. The blades attack on their own; you choose where to stand and when to walk.
how.move.title: Walk
how.move.text: The blades spin in a wide orbit and clear your path as you move through the crowd.
how.stand.title: Stand
how.stand.text: The blades draw in close and spin faster, melting a tough enemy at short range.
how.parry.title: Parry
how.parry.text: Purple projectiles vanish when they hit a blade. Red area warnings have to be dodged.
journey.title: Journey through the Ages
journey.lead: {eras} ages, {realms} mythological realms, {maps} maps. Every realm has its own enemies, map rule, weapon and boss. When an age's realms are cleared, its guardian waits at the gate.
journey.erased: Silik has erased the memory of this age. It will return as the journey goes on.
era.era_1.blurb: Stone boars charge across the hill of standing stones; in the cedar forest of Uruk, roots lay traps.
era.era_2.blurb: Sandstorms narrow your sight, labyrinth walls shift, and lightning strikes the storm mountains.
era.era_3.blurb: Ice makes the fjords slippery, steppe winds speed you up, and lights wander through the marsh.
heroes.title: Choose your hero
heroes.lead: {heroes} heroes, each from a mythological realm. The armour you wear shows on your hero.
fair.title: Fair play
fair.ads.title: No forced ads
fair.ads.text: An ad plays only when you choose to watch one, and it gives you a reward.
fair.myth.title: Respect for myths
fair.myth.text: You never fight the gods of living faiths. Bosses are the myths' own monsters and villains.
fair.gore.title: No gore
fair.gore.text: Defeated enemies crumble into their materials and turn into gold.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.when.q: When does Blades of Ages come out?
faq.when.a: Soon, on the App Store. The release date will appear on this page once it is set.
faq.devices.q: Which devices can I play on?
faq.price.a: It is free to download. The game has optional in-app purchases and no forced ads.
faq.langs.q: Which languages is it available in?
faq.myth.q: Are the myths in the game real?
faq.myth.a: The realms draw on real mythologies: Göbekli Tepe, the Epic of Gilgamesh, and Egyptian, Greek and Hittite myths. The bosses are monsters from these myths; the game's story and some characters are its own.
